hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "${f##*.}" in py) command -v ruff >/dev/null 2>&1 && { ruff format "$f" 2>/dev/null || true; ruff check "$f"; } || true ;; ts|tsx|js|jsx) command -v prettier >/dev/null 2>&1 && { prettier --write "$f" 2>/dev/null || true; }; command -v eslint >/dev/null 2>&1 && eslint "$f" || true ;; *) true ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
